text:
- **Owner questions and replies:** Ask-tool questions now get answered on the site as well as in chat, and the first answer wins. Questions close from hook events, and owner replies reach a session by push alone.
- **Checks and CI speed:** The AGENTS.md check gives the same verdict on every rerun and runs faster on pull requests. Full grading runs daily on main, and macOS Go jobs run once a day.
- **Record layer and site:** The owner agreed the record layer design. The site now renders the records branch and each draft version, with section diffs.
- **Repo and tool setup:** Claude Code no longer saves or loads auto memory in this repo. pm no longer installs a git hook, and this repo runs a newer pm release.
